subject: Request: Accelerator trial extension & supplemental credits for Horizon Labs
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@horizonlabs.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@horizonlabs.com>, procurement@horizonlabs.com
Date: 2027-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: trial extension + extra credits for pilot

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team here is excited about the latency and cost numbers you showed. We're about halfway through the 30‑day pilot but we hit a heavier ingestion test than we planned and burned through the initial allotment faster than expected.

Short version: can Horizon get a 30‑day extension and an extra 100k trial credits so we can finish the evaluation and include the inference pipeline in our production cost model?

What we can share now: current usage by environment and peak QPS during the spike — attaching a small CSV. We can also commit to a joint final review with your solutions engineer if you need logs or prompts.

Appreciate a fast turnaround — our procurement window closes Nov 12.

Best,
Sanjay Rao
Head of ML, Horizon Labs
Sanjay@horizonlabs.com

Attachments: usage_report_Q3.csv (CSV, 18KB)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@horizonlabs.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@horizonlabs.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-28T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension + extra credits for pilot

Hi Sanjay — thanks for the detail and the CSV. Quick read-through looks fine; appreciate you sending the peak QPS numbers.

Two quick asks so I can move this to approvals:
- Can you confirm the three most important SLA metrics you want us to include in the final review (latency P95, cost per 1k tokens, and KV cache hit rate are common).
- Are you able to sign the short terms summary so we can provision the extension while procurement finishes? I attached the current terms_summary_v2.pdf for reference.

I'm looping in Lauren (our commercial lead) for credit policy and Marissa (manager, credit exceptions) for the 100k supplemental ask. If we can get internal approval today/tomorrow I can push the extension ASAP.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

> On 2027-10-28 at 09:12, Sanjay Rao wrote:
> > Thanks again for the demo last week — the team here is excited about the latency and cost numbers you showed.
> > Short version: can Horizon get a 30‑day extension and an extra 100k trial credits so we can finish the evaluation and include the inference pipeline in our production cost model?

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@horizonlabs.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@horizonlabs.com>, procurement@horizonlabs.com
Date: 2027-10-29T08:24:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: trial extension + extra credits for pilot

Hi Karthik / Lauren —

Thanks for the quick reply. Confirming the three metrics we care about most (in order):
1) P95 latency for 1k token generations under our peak load (we measured ~220ms in your demo).
2) Cost per 1k tokens across typical prompts (we'll share a sample prompt set).
3) Model output quality for our reranker use case (will include small eval set).

We're fine signing the short terms summary to allow provisioning while procurement completes. Attaching a signed copy from my side (signed_and_scanned.pdf). Also attaching the usage CSV you mentioned in case it helps with batching/limits.

We'd like the extension to start Nov 1 and run through Nov 30 if possible.

Best,
Sanjay

Attachments: signed_and_scanned.pdf (PDF, 62KB), usage_report_Q3.csv (CSV, 18KB)

> On 2027-10-28 at 11:05, karthik_iyer wrote:
> > I'm looping in Lauren (our commercial lead) for credit policy and Marissa (manager, credit exceptions) for the 100k supplemental ask.

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-29T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Horizon Labs — supplemental trial credit request (100k) — escalation for approval

Lauren / Marissa —

Horizon (DEAL-7832) is asking for a 30‑day extension (Nov 1–30) and an additional 100,000 trial credits to complete a production‑scale ingestion test. They provided the signed short terms summary and usage CSV. Procurement wants the extension in place before their internal review completes.

Why I recommend approving:
- Strong fit: ML team has validated latency and is in procurement window (closing Nov 12).
- Upside: high likelihood of conversion to Dedicated capacity if quality checks pass; ARR motion probable within next 60–90 days.
- Low risk: credits limited to the pilot account; we can set token caps and a hard cutoff.

Proposal for approval:
- Provision 100,000 additional trial credits, active 2027-11-01 to 2027-11-30.
- Apply a hard token cap for the account and require a joint final review (Karthik + SE) before any further extension.
- Conditional on signing the standard terms (they already sent signed copy).

I've attached the current terms summary and the usage CSV they sent. If you approve, I'll issue the credits and notify Sanjay; if you want to alter the amount I can propose 75k instead.

Thanks —
Karthik

> Forwarded attachment: terms_summary_v2.pdf
> Forwarded attachment: usage_report_Q3.csv

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T09:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Horizon Labs — supplemental trial credit request (100k) — escalation for approval

Karthik —

Approve 100,000 trial credits for Horizon Labs with the following conditions:
1) Credits active 2027-11-01 through 2027-11-30 and cannot be extended without executive sign‑off.
2) Hard token cap enabled at account level and notifications to Karthik + SE at 80% burn.
3) Require joint final review session the week of Dec 1 to review P95 latency, cost-per-token, and reranker quality.
4) No refunds; credits expire at the end of term.

Please proceed. Karthik, send the confirmation to Sanjay and attach the DocuSign link for the short terms so procurement can close the loop.

Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Operations — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

> On 2027-10-29 at 10:12, karthik_iyer wrote:
> > Proposal for approval: Provision 100,000 additional trial credits, active 2027-11-01 to 2027-11-30.

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@horizonlabs.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@horizonlabs.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-01T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Approved: Horizon Labs extension & 100k trial credits (DEAL-7832)

Hi Sanjay — great news. We've approved a 30‑day extension for your pilot and added 100,000 supplemental trial credits to your account. Summary below:

- Credits: 100,000 trial credits granted
- Window: 2027-11-01 to 2027-11-30 (hard cutoff at 23:59 UTC on Nov 30)
- Controls: hard token cap applied; automated alerts at 80% and 100% burn to Karthik + assigned SE
- Conditions: joint final review the week of Dec 1 covering P95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, and quality for reranking.

Next steps for you:
1) Please sign the short terms via this DocuSign link so procurement has the executed copy: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/abcd1234
2) I'll schedule the joint review session after Nov 20 once you have the final logs and evals ready.

If procurement needs anything else or you want a walkthrough of the account controls, loop us in. Looking forward to the final review.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments included earlier: terms_summary_v2.pdf
